Release Notes for ASP.NET AJAX Extensions Source Code
-----------------------------------------------------

The ASP.NET AJAX Extensions Source Code release installs the source code and debugging symbols for
ASP.NET AJAX Extensions for use in maintaining and debugging your applications. You can install
the source code by itself or you can use it with Visual Studio 2005 or Visual Web Developer
Express Edition. You can get a free copy of Visual Web Developer Express Edition from
http://msdn.microsoft.com/vstudio/express/vwd/download/. When you install the source code with
one of these development environments, you can use the Visual Studio debugger to step into both
your own code and into the ASP.NET AJAX source code.

To provide feedback, please use the "AJAX Discussion and Suggestions" forum at http://forums.asp.net.   

Pre-Installation
----------------

If you want to use the ASP.NET AJAX Extensions Source Code with Visual Studio 2005 or Visual Web
Developer Express Edition, install the development environment before installing the ASP.NET AJAX
Extensions Source Code release.  Installing Visual Studio or Visual Web Developer first makes sure 
that the debugger in the development environment is automatically configured to work with the debugging
symbol files and source code.


Installation
------------

To install the release, from Windows Explorer, launch ASPAJAXSourceCode.msi. For silent or 
unattended installation, enter the following command at a Windows command prompt:

msiexec /i ASPAJAXSourceCode.msi [/q] [/log <logfile name>] [INSTALLPATH=<installation path>]

where:

- /q runs the installation in silent mode.
- <logfile name> is the path and file name of an optional log file.
- <installation path> is the path of an optional installation folder.
